package.name: orio_stretch
package.description: Team ORIO's mobile robot (Hello Robot Stretch RE1 with an Impinj RFID panel on the lift): dataset recording, ORB-SLAM3 mapping from a recording, camera-only navigation (ORB-SLAM3 localiser + depth obstacle cloud + move_base) and autonomous RFID passes. Nothing is compiled. The scripts add this package to ROS_PACKAGE_PATH themselves (scripts/orio_env.sh); data lives outside the repo under $ORIO_DATA (default ~/orio).
